steps.name: web client body: indexes and ceiling as strings, a ceiling below the file's rate transcodes
the same with numbers
no ceiling: direct play, subtitles still delivered by the profile
a ceiling above the file's rate stays direct
an index that is not a number is refused
a subtitle index with a fraction is refused
a ceiling that is not a number is refused
a segment count that is not a number is refused
a null segment count is refused
an empty index is no index
segment count and length as digit strings are taken
the first track plays directly
a later track is secondary: the profile refuses it although the codec is listed
no condition on IsSecondaryAudio: the later track plays directly
a condition limited to another codec does not apply
a condition naming the track's codec applies
NotEquals true is the same condition
Equals true: only the later tracks are accepted (the first one is refused)
the value is read in any case
the first entry that takes both codecs (first track)
the sound of the selected track picks the later entry
the picture comes first: an earlier entry that cannot take it is skipped
a picture match wins over a sound match
without any picture match the first entry stays
three entries: the sound picks the last
no entry takes the sound: the first picture match
transcoded with the flag: the selected track travels in the URL, with no method, and the flag ends it
the second track
the default track counts when none is named
with the copy flags the marker stays last
flag false: the profile delivers the track, nothing about it in the URL
the flag in the query is not read
not transcoding: nothing changes
a profile that cannot deliver the track: Encode with the index
no subtitle (-1) in a transcode: the method alone
a stream that does not exist: the index and the method
no subtitle named: nothing
